name: VR Shogi
summary:
Shogi, a traditional Japanese culture, can be played in a virtual space.

The pieces are controlled by hand tracking, so you can experience a realistic Shogi game.
The area where each piece can move is displayed on the board, so you can play Shogi without worrying about detailed rules.
You can play against the CPU or play against other players online.

Let's enjoy playing Shogi in a space we can't experience in real life!
